legend: Pou, Grisi, and Guilherme were starving, so they decided to have dinner at Subway. While they sat waiting for their meals and playing Brawl Stars, the kitchen exploded out of nowhere, sending food flying everywhere! Pou, being the only one quick on his feet, decided to take advantage of the situation to satisfy his hunger. He closed his game and prepared to attack!

All food items and Pou are located on a two-dimensional plane, where y=0$$$y = 0$$$ represents the ground. At time t=0$$$t = 0$$$, Pou is at position (0,0)$$$(0,0)$$$ and the i$$$i$$$-th food is at position (xi,yi)$$$(x_i,y_i)$$$. Each food falls at a constant vertical speed of 1$$$1$$$ unit per second, while Pou can move left or right at a constant speed of 1$$$1$$$ unit per second.

In other words, if in a time t$$$t$$$ a food item is at (x,y)$$$(x,y)$$$, at time t+1$$$t+1$$$ it will be at (x,y−1)$$$(x,y-1)$$$. Simultaneously, if in a time t$$$t$$$ Pou is at (x,0)$$$(x,0)$$$, at time t+1$$$t+1$$$ he can be at (x,0)$$$(x,0)$$$, (x+1,0)$$$(x+1,0)$$$, or (x−1,0)$$$(x-1,0)$$$.

Pou can eat food item i$$$i$$$ if and only if he is at position xi$$$x_i$$$ at the exact moment the food hits the ground (y=0$$$y = 0$$$). For hygiene reasons, he will not eat any food that has already touched the ground before his arrival.

Grisi and Guilherme were so stunned by the explosion that they forgot how many food items Pou ate, but they remember the initial positions of all the food items. Knowing that Pou ate the maximum possible amount of food, your mission is to determine that number.
input: The input consists of several lines. The first line contains n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤2⋅103$$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^3$$$), the number of food items.
The following n$$$n$$$ lines contain two integers x$$$x$$$ and y$$$y$$$ (1≤x,y≤106$$$1 \le x,y \le 10^6$$$), the i$$$i$$$-th line represents the initial position of food i$$$i$$$.
It is guaranteed that no two food items occupy the same initial position, that is: ∀i∀j((i≠j)⟹(xi,yi)≠(xj,yj))$$$\forall i\forall j((i\neq j) \implies (x_i,y_i) \neq (x_j,y_j))$$$.
output: The output must contain a single integer: the maximum number of food items Pou could have eaten.

legend.ai: Pou、Grisi 和 Guilherme 饿极了，于是决定去 Subway 吃晚餐。当他们坐在那里一边等餐一边玩《荒野乱斗》时，厨房毫无征兆地爆炸了，食物飞得到处都是！Pou 是唯一一个反应迅速的人，于是决定利用这一情况来填饱肚子。他关掉游戏，准备发起攻击！

所有食物和 Pou 都位于一个二维平面上，其中 y=0$$$y = 0$$$ 表示地面。在时间 t=0$$$t = 0$$$ 时，Pou 位于位置 (0,0)$$$(0,0)$$$，第 i$$$i$$$ 个食物位于位置 (xi,yi)$$$(x_i,y_i)$$$。每个食物都以每秒 1$$$1$$$ 个单位的恒定竖直速度下落，而 Pou 可以以每秒 1$$$1$$$ 个单位的恒定速度向左或向右移动。
当且仅当食物 i$$$i$$$ 落地的确切时刻(y=0$$$y = 0$$$)，Pou 位于位置 xi$$$x_i$$$ 时，他才能吃掉该食物。出于卫生原因，他不会吃任何在他到达之前就已经接触过地面的食物。
Grisi 和 Guilherme 被爆炸惊呆了，以至于忘记了 Pou 吃了多少食物，但他们记得所有食物的初始位置。已知 Pou 吃掉了尽可能多的食物，你的任务是确定这个数量。

input.ai: 输入由若干行组成。第一行包含 n$$$n$$$(1≤n≤2⋅103$$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^3$$$)，表示食物的数量。
接下来的 n$$$n$$$ 行每行包含两个整数 x$$$x$$$ 和 y$$$y$$$(1≤x,y≤106$$$1 \le x,y \le 10^6$$$)，第 i$$$i$$$ 行表示食物 i$$$i$$$ 的初始位置。
保证没有两个食物占据相同的初始位置，即：∀i∀j((i≠j)⟹(xi,yi)≠(xj,yj))$$$\forall i\forall j((i\neq j) \implies (x_i,y_i) \neq (x_j,y_j))$$$。

output.ai: 输出必须包含一个整数：Pou 最多可能吃掉的食物数量。
